tasks.title: Validate Host and block cross-site requests
tasks.summary: The dashboard token is returned by an unauthenticated /api/session and is protected only by an Origin-vs-Host check that DNS rebinding defeats.
steps: Reject any request whose Host is not localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1], or the configured HOST.
Reject requests with Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site.
Stop deriving the expected origin from req.headers.host; compare against the fixed allowlist.
Review /api/session: keep the loopback bootstrap, but do not hand the token to a non-allowlisted host.
acceptance: A request with Host: evil.example is rejected with 403 before any route runs.
Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site is rejected.
Legitimate localhost/127.0.0.1 requests are unaffected.
tests: Add test/host-guard.test.js covering allowed and rejected hosts.

tasks.title: Enforce Touch ID at runAction, not just the HTTP route
tasks.summary: The grant check lives only in POST /api/actions/:id, so rules and schedule fire danger:high actions with no grant.
steps: Move the Touch ID verification into runAction (or a wrapper every caller uses).
Pass the grant through from rules/schedule, or forbid danger:high actions in those configs.
Keep the HTTP-layer check as defence in depth.
acceptance: A danger:high action invoked via schedule without a grant is refused.
Interactive high actions still pass with a valid grant.
tests: Add a test that runAction('trash.empty') without a grant is refused.

tasks.title: Path-validate maintenance.loginItem and constrain uploads
tasks.summary: A traversal in loginItem plus /api/upload turns the token into arbitrary code execution via launchctl bootstrap.
steps: Reject any login-item name that is not a single segment directly inside ~/Library/LaunchAgents.
Assert dirname(resolved) === LA_DIR before existence/bootstrap.
Constrain what /api/upload may store and how it can be referenced.
acceptance: name: '../../x' and absolute paths are rejected.
A plist outside ~/Library/LaunchAgents cannot be bootstrapped.
tests: Add unit test for the loginItem name guard.

tasks.title: Gate native Touch ID credential enrollment
tasks.summary: native/register accepts any token-supplied public key, so a token holder can mint the second factor.
steps: Require a server-issued registration challenge plus an existing-credential assertion before enrolling a native key.
Or require a one-time bootstrap secret that only the local native app can obtain.
Never let a plain token add a credential.
acceptance: native/register without a valid ceremony is rejected.
Enrolling the first credential on a fresh install still works.
tests: Add test that token-only native/register is refused.

tasks.title: Fix unhandled stream errors that can crash the server
tasks.summary: createReadStream(...).pipe(res) has no error handler on the source; a file vanishing between stat and open throws an uncaught exception.
steps: Use stream.pipeline for static and image/icon/gallery responses.
Or attach an 'error' handler that ends/destroys the response.
acceptance: A read error on a served file does not exit the process.
The request fails cleanly (404/500) instead of crashing.
tests: Add a test simulating an unreadable file path.

tasks.title: First-run wizard: real Skip, dismiss, focus trap, no double-submit
tasks.source: audit O1, U1, U7, U8, O11
tasks.summary: The wizard cannot be dismissed, Skip setup just advances a step, there is no focus trap or Escape, and rapid clicks double-submit.
steps: Make Skip setup persist completedAt and close the wizard.
Add Escape and an explicit close affordance; return focus to the view on close.
Add onboardingRoot to syncScrollLock and trap focus while open.
Guard Continue/Skip during a transition and await persistOnboarding.
Persist currentStep in onboardingBack too.
acceptance: Skip setup reaches the dashboard in one click.
Escape closes the wizard, and focus returns to the dashboard.
Tab does not reach background controls while the wizard is open.
Rapid Continue clicks advance exactly one step and write one state.
tests: Manual: fresh run, Skip, Escape, keyboard-only pass.

tasks.title: Report ML runtimes honestly
tasks.summary: scanRuntimes pushes whisper.cpp/llama.cpp/MLX/ggml unconditionally, so Setup and the Runtimes page always claim they are installed.
steps: Only mark a runtime present when its binary/version probe succeeds.
Let viewRuntimes reach its empty state with install guidance when none resolve.
Fix missingComponents and the Get set up badge to count accordingly.
acceptance: On a Mac without these tools, Runtimes shows the empty state and Setup does not mark it ready.
With whisper.cpp installed, it is listed correctly.
tests: Extend scanner tests for present/absent runtimes.

tasks.title: Live views: preserve filter and keyboard focus across polls
tasks.summary: Monitor/Network polls replace whole subtrees, wiping the active filter and any focused control every 2-5s.
steps: Re-apply the active filter after each live re-render (loadMonitor, refreshProcRows, loadNetwork).
Skip the re-render while the subtree contains document.activeElement, or patch only changed values.
Re-target the row cursor after a re-render.
acceptance: A typed filter survives Monitor and Network polls.
Focus on a process Quit/Details button or range control is not stolen by a poll.
tests: Manual: type a filter on Monitor, wait 5s, confirm it holds.

tasks.title: Cache clear must not be undone by in-flight memoized work
tasks.summary: memo() rewrites the entry when an in-flight computation resolves after clear(), so post-action reclaim/health can stay stale for the TTL.
steps: Add a generation/epoch to the cache; drop results whose generation is stale.
Do the same for overview's own cache.
acceptance: Emptying Trash updates reclaimable bytes immediately, not after TTL.
tests: Add cache test: clear during in-flight fn.

tasks.title: Serialize metrics sampling / isolate fresh-sample deltas
tasks.summary: lastCpu/lastNet are mutated by both the 15s sampler and ?fresh=1, producing cpu:null and distorted net rates when they overlap.
steps: Add a single-flight guard around collectSample.
Prevent on-demand samples from mutating the sampler baselines (per-call snapshots).
acceptance: CPU tile never shows a spurious dash under concurrent polling.
Persisted net rates stay stable.
tests: Add unit test for the single-flight guard.

tasks.title: Bound pollJob retries and resolve orphaned jobs
tasks.summary: pollJob retries every 2s forever on a 404 after a server restart, leaving the job 'running' and the wake lock held.
steps: Add backoff and a retry cap.
On a non-transient error (404), mark the job failed/removed and stop.
acceptance: Restarting the server with a job open resolves the dock entry within a few seconds.
tests: Manual: start a job, restart the service, watch the dock clear.

tasks.title: Do not probe Full Disk Access implicitly on Overview load
tasks.summary: overview.report() reads ~/Library/Safari|Mail on load, which can fire the macOS TCC prompt before onboarding explains it.
steps: Remove the FDA probe from the default report path.
Gate it behind the explicit, explained action the wizard already uses.
Reuse the wizard's recorded state where possible.
acceptance: Loading Overview never triggers the 'access data from other apps' prompt on first run.
tests: Manual: fresh run, confirm no TCC prompt before the macOS access step.

tasks.title: Install helper must report the real result
tasks.summary: The helper install polls 40x without watching job status and shows success even when brew/install failed.
steps: Track the returned jobId; stop polling on done/failed.
Surface job.error; only show success when the notifier actually changed.
acceptance: On a Mac without Homebrew, the button ends in an error, not a false success.
tests: Manual: simulate a failing install.

tasks.title: Setup Open for not-installed components must not dead-end
tasks.summary: data-goto plus the available() gate silently redirects ComfyUI/OpenClaw setup rows to Overview, hiding their install guidance.
steps: For not-installed components, link to the install steps inline, or let the empty state render.
acceptance: Clicking Open on a not-installed component shows how to install it.
tests: Manual: Setup, click Open on a missing component.

tasks.title: Build the dashboard health check URL from HOST/PORT
tasks.summary: The dashboard health check hardcodes port 8790, so under the documented PORT override it reports the dashboard as down.
steps: Derive the URL from the configured HOST/PORT.
acceptance: Running on a non-default port does not report the dashboard as down.
tests: Start on an alternate port and confirm the dashboard check passes.

tasks.title: ComfyUI restart must target the real service label
tasks.summary: The ComfyUI view always offers restart of ai.openclaw.comfyui, which 403s for any other install.
steps: Only render the action when that label is present, or resolve the real label from the scan.
acceptance: Restart works when the service exists and is absent otherwise.
tests: Manual: with and without the label.

tasks.title: Settings can confirm Full Disk Access as granted
tasks.summary: /api/setup omits fullDiskAccess, so the Settings row always reads Optional even after granting.
steps: Offer the explicit Re-check on the Settings row, or persist the last probe result.
acceptance: After granting FDA, the Settings row reflects it.
tests: Manual: Re-check on the Settings row.

tasks.title: Refresh service rows on the action that changed them
tasks.summary: After Start/Stop/Restart the Services list is not re-rendered; rows stay stale until the next rescan.
steps: In refreshAfterAction for services, re-render the list (or patch the affected row) in addition to loadHealth().
acceptance: Stopping a service updates its row within a second.
tests: Manual: stop a service, watch the row.

tasks.title: Escape server strings in rows and tables
tasks.summary: Network interface rows pass iface.* raw through row(), and Security/Services interpolate port/pid raw into markup and data-*.
steps: esc() the joined interface string; esc() or numeric-coerce port/pid everywhere.
acceptance: No server-provided string reaches innerHTML unescaped in these views.
tests: Grep for raw interpolations in the cited functions.

tasks.title: Give toggle switches accessible names
tasks.summary: switchRow, settings booleans and wizard toggles render an unlabeled checkbox.
steps: Add aria-label or aria-labelledby pointing at the row title for every toggle input.
acceptance: A screen reader announces each toggle with its label.
tests: Manual: VoiceOver over Settings toggles.

tasks.title: Announce async results and wizard step changes
tasks.summary: Permission tests, ping/port results, scan status and 'Step N of M' update elements with no aria-live.
steps: Add role=status/aria-live=polite to .wc-status, #net-probe-result, #scan-status; announce wizard step changes.
acceptance: Async status changes are announced.
tests: Manual: screen reader pass.

tasks.title: Overview extras: show an error and retry instead of blanking
tasks.summary: loadOverviewExtras catches to null and blanks the health card/checklist with no error or retry.
steps: Render an error empty-state with a Retry button when the overview/series fetch fails.
acceptance: A failed extras load shows an error with a working Retry.
tests: Manual: block the request and reload.

tasks.title: Security hardening batch (low)
tasks.summary: Token rotation, constant-time compare, fresh-sample rate limiting, option injection, path-prefix/symlink reads, and webauthn grant hardening.
steps: Rotate the token per run (or document the persistent token accurately).
Use crypto.timingSafeEqual for the token compare.
Rate-limit /api/metrics/live?fresh=1.
Reject host/name tokens starting with '-'.
Anchor prefix checks with path.sep and resolve realpath on read routes.
WebAuthn: check signCount, bind grants to actionId + single use, require UV at registration.
acceptance: Each item is addressed or explicitly deferred with a note.
tests: Unit tests for the prefix check and option validation.

tasks.title: Bug hardening batch (low)
tasks.summary: serveStatic prefix check lacks a path separator; /api/ports/detail does not range-check port.
steps: Compare resolved === PUBLIC_DIR || startsWith(PUBLIC_DIR + path.sep).
Require an integer port in 1..65535 or return 400.
acceptance: Sibling 'public*' dirs are not served; invalid ports 400.
tests: Add unit tests for both.

tasks.title: Onboarding polish batch (low)
tasks.summary: ComfyUI copy button copies a docs URL; Pull Ollama model is offered without Ollama; security fix links open a generic pane.
steps: Give ComfyUI a real install command or relabel the button.
Hide the Pull Ollama action unless ollama.installed.
Map each security posture id to its specific deep link.
acceptance: Each of the three is corrected.
tests: Manual checks per item.

tasks.title: UI robustness batch (low)
tasks.summary: Disk refresh error discards the view; context-menu listener can re-add after removal; overlapping poll responses have no sequence guard.
steps: Keep prior disk content and overlay an inline error/retry; set aria-busy.
Register the context-menu close listener synchronously or track the pending timer.
Add a monotonic token to drop stale poll responses.
acceptance: Each item addressed; no regressions in Disk/Monitor.
tests: Manual checks.

tasks.title: Design uplift: onboarding
tasks.summary: Welcome step is nearly empty; the wizard re-centers between steps; mixed card language; bare progress bar.
steps: Render onboardingStackChips() on the welcome step with a one-line lede.
Top-align the wizard body with a min-height so the header stays put.
Render folder grants as wizardInfoCards.
Add progressbar semantics and reposition the step label.
acceptance: First impression shows what the app detected; steps stop jumping.
tests: Manual walkthrough.

tasks.title: Design uplift: core dashboard
tasks.summary: Inconsistent empty states; mixed table/row usage; no value-change motion; Monitor density is high for its cadence.
steps: Standardize core empty states on emptyState().
Pick one container type per data shape.
Add a short value-change fade gated by reduced-motion.
Collapse the Monitor trends/explain behind a disclosure.
acceptance: Core views feel consistent and calm.
tests: Manual walkthrough.
